feature: Training resource reviewer and publish flow

flows.name: Gate the review queue
steps: Open /training/review as an ordinary authenticated user
Open /training/review as an active app admin
Compare the visible navigation and queue data
flows.expectedOutcome: The ordinary user is denied before review data loads; the app admin sees the contextual Review queue action and pending queue.

flows.name: Publish or archive a pending resource
steps: Open and inspect a pending source
Refresh the reviewer queue and learner library
flows.expectedOutcome: Only review rows are decided, audit fields are recorded, stale decisions fail loudly, and published rows become learner-visible.

checks: The review queue is a plain resource list with no wrapper panels or KPI cards.
Publish is the primary action and Archive remains clearly secondary.
The empty queue and decision result are explicit at desktop and mobile widths.

claims.description: Only app admins can read or decide pending training resources.
Publish/archive decisions compare-and-set review rows and write audit fields without silently overwriting stale state.
The reviewer route is responsive, quiet, and failure-loud.
An independent reviewer approves the permission and stale-write boundary.
